name: pwsh
description:
Run commands in a PowerShell shell
* When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
* You don't have access to the internet via this tool.
* State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
* Use native Windows paths (C:\...) and $env:NAME variables; this is PowerShell, not bash.
* Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
* Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'Start-Job' or start a server with Start-Process.

command.description: The PowerShell command to run. Relative path is preferred in the command.

name: read_image
description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

name: team_task_create
description: Create one unowned pending task on the shared Team task board.

description.description: Complete task details and acceptance criteria.

blocked_by.description: Task ids that must complete first.

write_scopes.description: Advisory workspace-relative file or directory prefixes this task expects to modify.

name: team_task_get
description: Read the complete latest value of one shared task before changing or executing it.

name: team_task_list
description: List shared tasks, including readiness, owner, revision, blockers, and write-scope warnings.

owner.description: Optional owner agent name filter; cannot be combined with unowned.

unowned.description: Filter tasks by whether they have no owner; cannot be combined with owner.

limit.description: Number of rows, 1 through 100. Defaults to 50.

name: team_task_update
description: Compare-and-set a shared task action using the latest revision from team_task_get or team_task_list.

expected_revision.description: Current task revision used as the CAS precondition.

write_scopes.description: Replacement advisory write scopes for edit.

owner.description: Agent name of the root or any continuable descendant for root-only reassign; omit to unassign.

name: working_directory
description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.
